Advanced Online Security Included with BT Broadband | Bt.com

A Higher Standard of Cyber SecurityAll security features are included with BT Broadband
With Cyber Threat Protect, powered by Norton, we'll help you protect up to 15 devices and instantly identify scams. And what's more it's included with BT Broadband at no extra cost.
Get BT BroadbandLog in to activate

Protection That Never Stops

4 millionthreats blocked every day
We block access to over 4 millions harmful and scam website every single day.

73 millionnuisance calls blocked last year
Last year, we blocked more than 73 million nuisance calls before they could get through.

184 millionSMS scams blocked last year
Last year, over 184 million scam SMS messages were blocked before they even reached you.

Protection Across Your Digital World
From ransomware and viruses to suspicious messages and exposed data, Cyber Threat Protect helps keep your digital world secure.

Protect up to 15 devices
Protect all your devices
Protect up to 15 devices across PC, Mac, Android and iOS.

A scam-checking assistant
Protect against scams
Check suspicious messages, links or QR codes instantly with Scam Assistant.

Notifies you of breaches
Keep personal data secure
Protect up to 55 pieces of your personal data and we'll let you know if it shows up where it shouldn't.

Smarter, safer browsing
Browse safely
Stay safe from threats while browsing, banking and using social media.

Flag exposed details online
Monitor social media
Link your social media accounts and we'll tell you about suspicious activity or if you've been hacked.

Stronger passwords, less effort
Store and create passwords
Store and autofill passwords securely across your devices.

Get Protected in 3 Steps
Get Protected in 3 Simple Steps
Set up Cyber Threat Protect in just a few minutes.

STEP 1
Sign in and activate
Log in with your BT ID and switch on Cyber Threat Protect.Log in to activate

STEP 2
Download the app
Get Cyber Threat Protect from the App Store, Google Play, or your computer's app store.

STEP 3
Install on your devices
Follow the on-screen steps to install protection on up to 15 devices, including phones, tablets and laptops.View installation help
